title: 自组织数字电路
summary: 提出自组织数字电路，将功能逻辑生成与维护视为图上的元学习问题。采用拓扑掩码Transformer配置电路查找表，扩展神经细胞自动机范式，可从零自组装功能电路并快速绕过硬件故障，软错误恢复准确率超99.99%，且泛化到更宽电路。
summary_en: Introduces Self-Organising Digital Circuits, framing functional logic generation as meta-learning on graphs. A topology-masked Transformer configures LUTs, extending NCA to self-assemble circuits and reroute around faults, achieving >99.99% recovery and generalization to wider circuits.
